video_caption: The video opens with a black screen featuring a circular logo with the letters "EIM" in a metallic bronze color on a dark green background, surrounded by subtle white streaks, and the text "EVERYTHING INSIDE ME" below it. This transitions to a wide shot of a paved road with a white dashed line down the center, flanked by green grass and a low stone wall. In the background, there's a charming white house with dark window frames, surrounded by lush green trees, nestled in a valley with rolling green hills and mountains under a bright, cloudy sky. At the top of the screen, text overlays appear: "@Insidemeiseverything" and "bitchute.com/eim". A red "SUBSCRIBE" button appears over the road, which a white mouse cursor then clicks. Shortly after, a large, bold red text overlay with dashed lines on either side emerges across the screen, stating: "---"FOUND IN THE WRONG PLACE"--- ~ Forbidden Science". This text then fades out, and speech bubbles appear sequentially at the bottom of the screen against the unchanging background, with the speaker saying, "Hi everyone!", "How are you today?", "I hope you are always healthy.", and finally, "Welcome back to my channel."

The video segment, viewed from a moving vehicle with visible raindrops on the windshield, displays a two-lane asphalt road curving to the left. On the right side of the road, a white, two-story house with dark windows and a blue garbage bin sits amidst green grass and trees, backed by rolling green hills under a cloudy sky. A low stone wall runs alongside the road, separating it from the house's property. At 00:04, a white car appears on the right side of the road and proceeds to drive past the house towards the left, disappearing from view by 00:07. Overlaid text at the top left shows "EIM" and "@insidemeiseverything," while the top right displays "bitchute.com/eim." Subtitles at the bottom read: "Like always, today I'm going to discuss some topic that will make you wonder about the advanced technology of the past. I got this on a telegram channel called “Forbidden Science”. Please check the description to know more about the channel."

The video opens at 00:02 with a dashcam perspective, showing an asphalt road with two white dividing lines, a red triangular warning sign on the left, and raindrops on the windshield, indicating a wet environment. Green fields, trees, and distant hills under a cloudy sky form the backdrop. Overlaid text at the bottom reads, "Anyway, I also have a telegram channel (t.me/everythinginsideme). There, I will share various information that I cannot share here." The top of the screen displays social media handles: "@insidemelseverything" (Instagram logo) and "bitchute.com/elm" (Bitchute logo), along with an "EIH" logo. At 00:08, the scene rapidly blurs and transitions to a clearer daytime view of an asphalt road with railroad tracks down its center, surrounded by green landscapes and a blue sky with a large white cloud. The overlaid text changes to "Don't forget to subscribe to my backup YouTube channel, the link is also in the description box below." Around 00:15, new text appears: "So, without further ado, fasten your pants and let's get started!", which quickly gives way to "The source of the information I provide may be the same, or the result of plagiarism from other authors. Surely, I will always try to convey the source as best I can." The screen then darkens momentarily from 00:27 before brightening again. At 00:29, a prominent yellow number "1" appears centrally, accompanied by the text "https://t.me/taboo_science1", as a percussive beat begins. From 00:34, a smaller, square video inset appears on the right, displaying an aerial view from a plane (with its wing visible) of a green, mountainous landscape featuring a distinct pyramid-shaped hill. The main screen's bottom text identifies this as "Pyramid in Bosnia."

The video segment features a static shot of a green, hilly landscape under a blue sky with scattered white clouds, with what appears to be a road or bridge in the blurry foreground. Overlaid in the center is a smaller, square-shaped image showing an aerial view from what looks like a small plane (part of its wing is visible at the top of the inset), looking down at a large, conical, green hill covered in dense forest and some cleared patches. At the top right, there are social media handles: "@insidemeiseverything" with the Instagram logo, and "bitchute.c" with the BitChute logo. A stylized "EIM" logo is present in the top left corner. Subtitles at the bottom of the screen read, "Because, having agreed that in the center of Europe there are ancient pyramids, similar to the Egyptian pyramids, we have to come to the conclusion that the history of our world was not at all the same as written in history textbooks."

The video opens with an aerial photograph, seemingly taken from an airplane window with part of the wing visible at the top, showing a lush, green, mountainous landscape covered in dense forests and some grassy clearings. This central image is overlaid on an animated background depicting a serene, green countryside with rolling hills, scattered trees, a winding road with stone walls, and a bright blue sky. Throughout the first 26 seconds, three different text captions appear at the bottom of the screen, describing the image: first, "Under the 1.5 meter layer of earth, on which grows trees and shrubs, there are huge stone blocks, tightly docked one to another."; second, "Moreover, excavations were carried out at different points of the mountain, and everywhere under the soil layer there was a stone base."; and third, "In addition, an aerial photograph showed that the sides of the mountain are perfectly straight and form angles of 90 degrees." In the top left corner, the stylized text "EIM" is displayed, while the top right features Instagram and BitChute logos with text "@insidemelseverything" and "bitchute.com/eim" respectively. At 0:26, the central aerial photograph fades out, replaced by a large yellow number "2" in the center of the screen, with the text "https://t.me/taboo_science1" (meaning a Telegram link) appearing below it. The animated green countryside background continues, showing a dark-colored car driving along the road briefly before the segment ends.

The video segment opens with a dynamic background featuring a vibrant green, hilly landscape with trees, stone walls, and a dirt path, resembling a video game environment. In the foreground, two images are displayed side-by-side: on the left, an ornate, carved stone bridge or archway with intricate details and traditional stone buildings; on the right, a plain, modern concrete bridge with a red metal railing and simple concrete supports over a small stream. Overlaying these images, white text at the bottom initially reads "Bridges then and bridges now." This text then changes to "And this is not the worst bridge yet. It is scary to live in a regressive world where you are assured that progress is being made." Finally, the text changes to "It's scary to live with people who don't understand that." At the top of the screen, social media handles "@insidemeiseverything" and "bitchute.com/eim" are displayed. At 0:14, the two bridge images disappear, and the green landscape background fills the entire frame, continuing its slow, forward-moving animation.

The video segment opens with a serene aerial view of a verdant, hilly landscape featuring lush green fields, scattered trees (including one with striking reddish foliage), stone walls dividing the terrain, and a winding dirt path in the foreground under a cloudy sky, with distant houses nestled in the hills. Overlayed at the top are social media handles: "@insidemelseverything" (with an Instagram logo) and "bitchute.com/eim" (with a BitChute logo). A voice-over encourages viewers to like, subscribe, and click the notification bell, prompting a red "SUBSCRIBE" button to appear and be clicked by a white mouse pointer, followed by the text "3SCR" briefly appearing on screen. The scene then abruptly cuts to black at 0:17 before transitioning to a dashboard camera view from inside a vehicle driving along a winding asphalt road, with visible raindrops on the windshield, surrounded by green trees, stone walls, and distant hills. A black car is seen driving ahead on the left side of the road, and a large yellow number "3" is prominently displayed in the center of the screen, with a Telegram link "https://t.me/taboo_science1" (English: https://t.me/taboo_science1) below it, as a voice-over states, "Anyway, three ingredients are needed to make gunpowder: saltpeter, sulfur and coal."

The video segment opens with a view from a moving vehicle on a winding road through a green, hilly landscape. In the center, a white frame displays a black and white illustration of an ancient Chinese warrior or scholar, in a cap and robes, holding a torch and standing next to a long, horizontally mounted rocket launcher on a tripod. Overlay text at the bottom reads, "Anyway, three ingredients are needed to make gunpowder: saltpeter, sulfur and coal." A red car drives into view and then away in the background as the caption changes to "There has always been coal in China," then "Until the 18th century, native sulphur was only available at the mouth of the volcano Etna, in Sicily," and "The nearest deposit of saltpeter was on the island of Ceylon." The road background then darkens as the text states, "Of the entire Mendeleev Table, only saltpeter and sulfur can be components of black powder, all other fast-acting substances are explosive, and any cannon would be blown to pieces if used." The background brightens again as the final question for this segment appears: "How could China invent gunpowder with only 1 of 3 components?" The video then transitions to a scene on a wet asphalt road, where a large yellow number "4" and the text "https://t.me/taboo_science1" are overlaid. This is followed by a shot over a railway track in a green, hilly environment. A central image then appears, showing a rugged, rocky landscape with fractured basalt slabs covered in moss and lichen, accompanied by the text, "Mount Karnasurta in the Polar region boasts basalt slabs with perfectly even faces." The central image changes to a close-up of a rocky, layered cliff face, and the text reads, "The blocks stand out against the rest of the stone scrap, and their processing allows you to take them as they are and use them for construction." This image then shifts to a pile of large, roughly rectangular stone blocks, continuing the same caption. The final image in this sequence shows a large, flat, moss-covered stone slab with other rocks and a measuring stick, with the caption, "Do you think these are traces of ancient civilizations? Scientists think it's a natural formation." The video concludes by returning to the railway track scene, displaying a large yellow number "5" and the text "https://t.me/taboo_science1". Throughout the video, social media handles "@insidemeiseverything" and "bitchute.com/eim" are consistently displayed at the top of the screen.

The video segment features a central rectangular frame displaying a painting, possibly historical, showing a large landscape with a river or body of water. Numerous figures, some on horseback and others in boats, traverse the scene. The background of the painting is a lush green landscape with trees. Two pink circles highlight specific elements within the painting: the left circle encompasses several tall, long-necked creatures, some with riders, positioned near the river, resembling dinosaurs or very tall giraffes. The right circle highlights two similar creatures, also appearing large and ridden. Overlay text at the bottom reads, "So people knew about dinosaurs back in the 16th century? (So people knew about dinosaurs back in the 16th century?)" which then transitions to, "If you look closely, you will see 3 dinosaurs in the center of the painting, with riders sitting on them. Many people would think they were camels, but they weren't. (If you look closely, you will see 3 dinosaurs in the center of the painting, with riders sitting on them. Many people would think they were camels, but they weren't.)". The top right corner of the screen displays social media handles "@insidemeiseverything" and a URL "bitchute.com/elm". The background behind the central frame is a blurry outdoor scene with green hills and a road.

The video segment displays a central image of an excavated, ancient sarcophagus or coffin, appearing metallic with a greenish-blue patina and intricate designs, possibly still embedded in earth or a wooden structure. Around this central image, the background shows a blurred, lush green landscape featuring rolling hills, scattered trees, and a faint glimpse of a road on the left. Overlaying the video are several text elements: a logo "EIN" in the top left corner, social media handles "[INSTAGRAM LOGO] @insidemeiseverything" and "[BITCHUTE LOGO] bitchute.com/eim" at the top center and right respectively. At the bottom of the screen, a caption reads, "The opening of a Chinese tomb in Taiyuan city has given people a find in the form of a gold sarcophagus from the Tang dynasty." No people are visible in this segment.

The video segment opens with an aerial shot of the Patom crater, a large, circular, conical mound, situated amidst a vast, verdant forested landscape under a clear blue sky. On-screen text (in English) reads, "The Patom crater was long thought to be the result of the Tunguska explosion. When scientists studied the trees growing on its slope, it turned out that they appeared before the meteorite impact, but, instead, they witnessed... A nuclear explosion? Judging by the annual rings of trees, in 1845 in the crater area there was a fivefold increase in the radioactive isotope in the wood, which lasted for several decades. The same pattern is observed in the nuclear test area. The reasons for the increased background radiation at a time when nuclear research was out of the question are still not clear." At 0:40, the scene transitions to a black screen displaying a large yellow number "8" and a Telegram link, "https://t.me/taboo_science1". This then fades into an aerial view of a rural landscape featuring a straight train track running parallel to a road and crossing a small bridge, surrounded by green fields and trees under a bright sky. The yellow number "8" and the Telegram link remain on screen, while new text appears at the bottom (in English) stating, "Is it true that we now live much longer than our ancestors did?", accompanied by a subtle, distant siren-like sound.

The video segment opens with a question overlaid on a black bar at the bottom: "Is it true that we now live much longer than our ancestors did?". The screen is divided, with the left side showing a blurred, wide shot of a green, hilly landscape with what appears to be a road or train tracks in the foreground. The right side features a clear, central image of a weathered stone monument or marker, possibly in a forest, with reddish-brown leaves on the ground around its base. A red rectangular box highlights an inscription on the stone, which reads "Joh. Kepler" with dates "1630-1930" etched below it.

The video segment opens with a wide shot of a scenic countryside, featuring a winding asphalt road in the foreground, a traditional white house with a grey roof situated on the right side of the road, surrounded by green trees and stone walls, with rolling hills in the background under a bright, slightly overcast sky. At 0:04, the text "To be continued..." appears in the center of the screen, indicating a forthcoming continuation. This text is replaced at 0:09 by a source attribution: "source: Forbidden Science https://t.me/taboo_science1" (This is the source of the video's content, which appears to be a Telegram channel). A red banner with the word "SUBSCRIBE" then appears on the house at 0:14, and a white mouse cursor is seen clicking it. After the subscribe banner disappears, a light-colored car with roof racks drives from the left to the right side of the road at 0:21. The scene then transitions abruptly at 0:24 into a dynamic, kaleidoscopic tunnel of colorful light streaks (green, blue, orange, and black), which briefly coalesces into a glitchy, pixelated sphere displaying fragmented images. This sphere quickly resolves into a teal circular logo featuring the stylized "EIM" initials, followed by a partially glitched and illegible line of text below it at 0:28, likely a channel name or tagline. No people are visible throughout the segment.
